data.raw_text:
TRAFFIC ADVISORY

In connection with VVIPs/VIPs visit at ‘Sadaiv Atal’ on 25.12.2025, on the occasion of the birth anniversary of Late Sh. Atal Bihari Vajpayee, Ex. Prime Minister of India, traffic movement in and around the area is likely to be affected from 05:00 AM to 11:00 AM.

📍 STRETCHES AFFECTED / RESTRICTED:
-Ring Road (Rajghat to Salim Garh Y-Point)
-Raja Ram Kohli Marg towards Shanti Van Chowk
-Nishad Raj Marg towards Shanti Van Chowk

📍 DIVERSION POINTS:
-Salim Garh Y-Point
-Salim Garh Bypass Cut
-Raja Ram Kohli Marg (near loop towards ISBT Kashmiri Gate)
-Under Salim Garh Flyover
-T Point, Subhash Marg
-Sunehari Masjid Cut on Nishad Raj Marg

📍 ADVISORY FOR COMMUTERS:
-Avoid the above roads during the notified hours
-Plan your journey well in advance
-Prefer public transport and avoid personal vehicles

📍 GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS:
-Park vehicles only at designated parking areas
-Avoid roadside parking
-Follow traffic rules and obey directions of traffic personnel

📍 Stay updated through Delhi Traffic Police channels

#DPTrafficAdvisory
